items.name: S.Space
items.description: Your team and everyone's AI agents, in one workspace. Everyone on your team has an AI agent, and none of them work together, so you copy, paste and re-explain all day. S.Space is one workspace for your team and everyone's agents. Bring the ones you already use, like Claude Code and Codex, from any vendor. items.name: Toone
items.description: Grokbot meets n8n/zapier. Toone: Grokbot meets n8n/zapier. Build precise agentic workflows and routines in natural language. Each node is an agent's chat thread on the model you pick (ChatGPT or Claude), or an automatic step that runs the same way every time without AI. Run repeatable routines, babysit them with agents, polish as they run, pause and continue anytime. It analyzes satellite imagery, geometries, geography data, and your organization's first party data, writes and debugs the analysis, and delivers results in hours. When the work needs to run continuously, Waldo turns it into a scheduled pipeline on your existing data platform. Built for spatial analytics at scale by the creators of Apache Sedona.

Describe what you want, start from a template, or bring the file, and you get a workflow with every step laid out. items.name: Tencent Hy4 flash
items.description: Fast, low-cost model from $0.07/M input. Hy4 flash is Tencent’s most cost-effective Hy model to date, with 224B total parameters, 12B active, multimodal input and a 1M-token context. Per Tencent, it decodes above 150 tokens per second and costs about $0.07 per million input tokens and $0.28 output. It targets everyday tasks like document work, slides, deep research and computer use, while Hy4 handles harder engineering. Open-sourcing is planned, but the weights are not out yet.

items.name: uRun
items.description: Real-time decisions for voice and video agents. Sense is a real-time decision model for voice and video agents. You write the questions, Sense returns the decisions, and your agent acts on them. Build with the SDK for real-time sessions, or send single requests to explore. New accounts start with 1,000 in free credits.

items.name: Polylane for CI
items.description: Fix broken builds before they block your team. When CI fails on main or in your merge queue, Polylane reads the job logs, finds the commit that broke the build, and opens a fix pull request. It runs your build and tests before review, fixes CI failures on its own PRs, and closes the issue when main is green again. Works with GitHub Actions, Depot, and CI that reports checks to GitHub.

It audits accessibility under any law: WCAG 2.2, ADA, EAA, Section 508, EN 301 549 and 14 more. Its open-source CLI makes it a go / no-go gate in CI. Free to start.
